result_root_precondition: Path must not exist and every parent component must be a non-symlink directory.
lease_precondition: The runtime lease path and its acquisition lock are absent before any non-lease phase creates output; a managed runner owns and removes both during measured execution.
full_runtime_claim: diagnostic only until a current-host Geekbench 5 single-core receipt exists

phase_layout.immutable_after: command manifest and authority identities frozen
source closure and program lock verified
binary A/B and compiler trace decision
three frozen reset-state integer-probability and within-scope trajectory populations terminal
one cumulative 1M probability, payload, inverse, cleanup, resource calibration, and independent verification terminal
opening-prefix and distant cold-reset 10M identity, resource, and independent verification terminal
full A encode, decode, diagnostic resource, package, and cleanup terminal
full B encode, decode, diagnostic resource, package, and cleanup terminal
validated online probability digest reproduces retained 10M trace digests and full parent/q1 byte-zero streams match
consolidated receipt and independent verification terminal

scratch_precondition: Each scratch path must be absent before its phase, must resolve to a non-tmpfs/non-ramfs filesystem, and may not be shared between phases. File-backed FXCM state on /dev/shm is forbidden because it would remain memory-backed.
scratch_terminal_rule: Each phase records logical and allocated peaks before cleanup, removes only its own scratch root, and records zero bytes afterward.
write_isolation_rules: Each measured phase writes only its numbered result directory and dedicated disk-backed scratch root.
Qualification phase is read-only over phases 00 through 10 and writes only 11_qualification.
No phase may rotate, truncate, rename, or replace a prior phase directory.
No terminal failure may reuse a result root; correction-only successors receive a new versioned root.
independent_build_rule: Full A executes build-A binary and full B executes build-B binary; their source closures are identical and their binaries must be byte-identical before parent qualification.
phase_transition_rule: A phase starts only after every prerequisite phase is terminal and its required decision is positive; a truthful negative decision routes to the frozen terminal branch instead of continuing.
required_terminal_artifacts: three fixed reset-state scope probability/trace/payload/inverse identity receipts
cumulative 1M identity and resource calibration receipt
opening-prefix and distant cold-reset 10M transfer receipt
full A and B archive, inverse, resource, package, and cleanup receipts
validated online full-stream integer-probability digest identity receipt
